intro: Professionals and everyday users convert acres (ac) to square miles (mi²) when working across imperial and imperial standards in real estate property deeds, agricultural land surveying, commercial floor plan leases, and civil zoning. One acre equals 0.001563 square miles, while 1 square mile equals 640 acres. Whether you are verifying area specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many square miles (mi²) are in 1 acre (ac)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.0015625 square miles (mi²) in 1 acre (ac), which rounds to 0.0016 mi² for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 square mile equals 640 acres.

faqs.question: How do I convert acres to square miles (ac to mi²)?
faqs.answer: To convert acres to square miles, use the formula: mi² = ac × 0.0015625. For example, converting 5 ac gives 0.0078 mi².

faqs.question: What is 5 acres in square miles?
faqs.answer: 5 acres (ac) equals exactly 0.0078 square miles (mi²) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
